prompts:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high fidelity Korean elementary grade 4 classroom web app STUDENT LOGIN HOME mockup, one landscape desktop screen, crisp high resolution legible Korean, no device frame. This is a redesigned screen for DJ48 퀴즈타운, using provided image 1 as structural reference and image 2 as diary interaction context. Preserve reference 1's three column structure: left navigation, a large personal STUDENT CARD centered in the middle with a friend avatar carousel beneath, and right activity cards. Change the teacher account to a fictional student. Do not copy reference third party branding, watermark, currencies Berry, stock market, or teacher account.

Visual direction: charming premium classroom game UI, airy rounded white panels, soft cream background with muted peach/lilac/mint gradient blobs, dark navy readable Korean sans serif, blue-violet main accents. Rich, VARIED original illustrated artwork is crucial: each feature has a different recognizable colored illustration in a coherent soft 2.5D clay/picture-book style with rounded silhouettes, no repetitious shopping bags or generic check icons. Balance gentle visual richness with uncluttered usable cards. Not a plain enterprise dashboard. All screen edges and controls fully visible.

Left sidebar about 16% width: header '4학년 8반' and '우리 교실', nav pill buttons with distinct illustrations labeled '내 카드' selected, '마음 일기', '마켓', '젬스톤', '직업', '은행', '내 방'. Small bottom button '타운으로'. Middle about 54%: friendly small heading '별이야, 반가워!' and subtitle '오늘도 우리 교실에서 함께 자라요'. A substantial rounded white student identity card with a little decorative classroom bookshelf/desk scene, a large circular playful cartoon avatar of a Korean child wearing a mint hoodie (not teacher or wizard), name '14 별이', role chip '도서 도우미'. Three large illustrated action tiles inside: open pink diary with pencil '일기 쓰기', a colorful treasure scrapbook '나의 기록', a collection of three distinct gemstone shapes '나의 젬'. Bottom card stats: '레벨 4', '포인트 35.5 P', 'DJ코인 120', correctly separated currencies. Under main card place a compact inviting diary prompt banner with a smiling yellow sun character and paper envelope: '오늘 어떤 하루였어?' with prominent blue-violet button '마음 일기 쓰기'. Then a horizontal '우리반 친구들' carousel, four distinct avatar mini cards: cat explorer, child with blue glasses, bunny astronaut, child with purple bob. Labels '나', '민준', '하린', '지우'; small explicit button '친구 일기 보기'. Keep self/avatar relationship logical, self mint hoodie avatar.

Right rail about 28%, heading '오늘의 활동', four separate illustrated action cards with different accents and images: owl carrying a notice envelope '학급 알림' / '새 소식 1개'; fox holding an open checklist with a telescope '오늘의 퀘스트' / '3개 중 1개 완료'; bunny watering a plant beside a small calendar '성장루틴' / '오늘 체크하기'; small book tree with two diverse animal helpers '우리반 미션' / '함께 읽기 45%'. Bottom slim notification card '내 일기에 새 댓글 2개' with two miniature avatars and a small speech bubble.
Text concise, Korean exact as given where feasible. No lorem ipsum, no English marketing headline, no extraneous annotations, no watermarks. This is a finished UI screenshot with attractive differentiated illustrations, NOT a design moodboard or wireframe.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high fidelity Korean elementary grade 4 classroom app DIARY AND FRIEND COMMENTS MODAL mockup, one landscape desktop screen, no device frame. Provided reference 2 establishes a wide rounded modal with diary on the left and comments on the right, reference 1 establishes the underlying student-card home. Redesign it to visually match: creamy very light peach/mint/lilac backdrop, rounded white panels, dark navy Korean typography, blue-violet primary buttons, charming diverse soft 2.5D clay/picture-book illustrations. Keep legible Korean and all buttons visible. The colorful student home is gently blurred behind the modal, not dominant. No teacher account, no third party logo, no watermark.

Modal occupies 90% screen with roomy margins. Header circular fictional mint-hoodie child avatar, title '별이의 마음 일기', subtitle '오늘의 마음을 기록하고 친구와 이야기를 나눠요', top right close X. Tab row '내 일기' active and '친구 일기' inactive; compact friend avatar selector strip next to second tab with three distinct small illustrated child avatars. Date navigation on right '10월 17일 (토)' with chevrons.

Below divide into two panels about 55/45 with gentle vertical rule. LEFT is current student's editable diary, not someone's private diary. Heading '오늘의 기분'. A horizontal set of six visibly DIFFERENT illustrated expressive mood characters, in coherent style but distinct faces/shapes: joyful yellow sun, excited peach star, calm green leaf, tired sleepy lavender moon, sad blue raindrop, angry coral cloud. Each label respectively '기뻐요', '설레요', '편안해요', '피곤해요', '슬퍼요', '속상해요'. Joyful sun selected with blue-violet ring, not just a color gradient slider. Medium heading '오늘의 이야기'. A clean bordered white writing area with clear sample Korean diary text in 3 lines: '오늘 친구들과 함께 책을 읽었다.\n민준이가 재미있는 부분을 알려 주어서 웃었다.\n내일도 같이 읽고 싶다.' Small book-and-pencil sticker in corner, remaining area breathable. Below writing area visible audience control label '공개 범위' with two options '나만 보기' and selected '우리반 공개'; helper '우리반 친구들이 읽고 댓글을 남길 수 있어요.' Then bottom aligned buttons secondary '취소' and strong primary '일기 저장'. Small saved-state text '우리반에 공개한 일기'.

RIGHT heading '친구들의 댓글' with count badge '2'. Show actual friendly comments, not empty state: avatar boy with blue glasses, name '민준', time '방금', bubble '나도 재미있었어! 내일도 같이 읽자.'; avatar girl with purple bob, name '하린', time '5분 전', bubble '어떤 책이야? 나도 읽어 보고 싶어!'. Add tasteful tiny heart/book/speech-bubble illustrated stickers in margin, do not fill with random clutter. Light friendly hint '서로에게 힘이 되는 말을 남겨요'. A comment input anchored at panel bottom with placeholder '친구에게 따뜻한 댓글을 남겨요' and clear blue-violet '댓글 등록' button. Maintain sufficient text contrast and generous controls. Show functional-looking writing and comments UI as a finished screenshot, not explanatory flowchart. Do NOT add unrelated counseling/diagnostic tabs, do NOT show real student names or data. Illustration variety and joyful school-friendly visual quality are essential.
